full_details: He had been across the water. He paid Henslowe twelve pence on his own debt and saw it written down. Yesterday's play is set against the thirtieth. By that book, today is the thirty-first of April. The sums were right to the farthing. You said a man may lose a day, and nobody loses a shilling by mistake. Kemp offered a thirty-second of May for sixpence, and it was not paid. You were in the Shrew. The name is not on the leaf. The company's word for never is on the leaf.
one_sentence: At Tipping's, Raye's twelve pence and a page dated out of the month became the company's word for never.
title: Heard the company's word for never at Tipping's
